privacyBody: Campaign Run stores progress on this device by default. If you create an account we also store your email, your board name and your scores on our server. Contender choice is sensitive: it stays local until you give explicit consent, and it is never attached to a public score. Scores are game scores, not polls. We do not sell Contender choice for political advertising. Lawyer review of the full privacy notice is still required before public launch.
termsBody: This is a fictional game for players 18+. Play fair. Do not use the game to claim real election results. Disclosure applies everywhere: fictional characters and events; not affiliated with any party, aspirant, or electoral body. Lawyer review of the full terms is still required before public launch.
contenderConsentBody: Your Contender choice can stay on this device forever. If you consent, and you are signed in, your Contender id is stored on the server separately from your public score so the live map can colour a state (Nigeria Data Protection Act style consent). Withdrawing consent erases the ids already stored. You can export or delete your data any time in Account.
contenderConsentAccept: I consent to Contender data leaving this device
guestSaveBody: Keep playing as a guest, or save a name on this device so your export and consent log stay attached to you here. A device name is separate from an account: signing in is what carries your board to another phone.
